name: Karam HS31 Supported Nitrile Coated Heavy Duty Work Gloves
shortDescription: Heavy-duty cotton-lined work gloves fully dipped in thick blue nitrile with safety cuff for high abrasion, puncture, grease, and hydrocarbon protection.
overview: The Karam HS31 gloves are engineered to deliver unyielding hand defense during heavy industrial handling of sharp, rough, oily, and abrasive materials. Constructed with a comfortable, moisture-absorbing 100% cotton interlock jersey liner, the exterior is fully coated in a thick, vulcanized blue nitrile elastomer. This seamless nitrile barrier repels grease, cutting fluids, oils, and petroleum solvents while offering supreme resistance against tearing and punctures from sheet metal edges, cast iron burrs, and rough timber.
keyFeatures: Fully dipped heavy-duty blue nitrile coating providing total oil and liquid repellency
Soft 100% cotton interlock liner keeps hands dry and cushioned during long shifts
High mechanical strength conforming to EN 388 (Abrasion Level 4, Tear Level 2)
Textured rough palm finish provides a firm, slip-resistant grip on oily components
Rigid canvas safety cuff enables rapid emergency donning and removal
Resistant to mineral oils, hydraulic greases, and common industrial chemicals
Anatomical shape minimizes hand fatigue during continuous heavy manual lifting

specifications.Coating Coverage: Full Dip (Palm, Fingers, and Back of Hand)
specifications.Color: Navy Blue Coating with White Cuff

applications: Handling rough castings, metal forgings, and stampings
Automotive engine assembly, oil changes, and gearbox repairs
Metal recycling, scrap sorting, and waste management
Heavy machinery maintenance and pipe yard logistics
